reads.sql: SELECT guildid, name FROM guild WHERE name IN (%s)

SELECT character_name AS name, new_level AS level, guild_id, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created_at) AS at FROM overseer_level WHERE guild_id IN (%s) AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL %s DAY ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT %s

SELECT id, guild, band, composition, keyword, tank, members, dungeon_by, dungeon_jev, dungeon_confidence, composition_by, composition_jev, composition_confidence, prior_rate, prior_runs, state, outcome, why, deaths, seconds_inside, bosses_done, bosses_total, loot_items, loot_notable, ilvl_gained, levels_gained, created_at, ended_at, proposer, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created_at) AS created_unix, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(ended_at) AS ended_unix FROM overseer_guild_run WHERE guild IN (%s) AND ended_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL %s DAY AND outcome IN (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT %s
SELECT c.name, gm.guildid AS guild_id FROM guild_member gm JOIN characters c ON c.guid = gm.guid WHERE gm.guildid IN (%s)
